item.title: 🤝 Merger · Definitive · AYA
item.scanner:headline: Acquires 139 km² Cu-Ag portfolio for C$4M in shares
item.description:
Acquires 139 km² Cu-Ag portfolio for C$4M in shares

Agreed to acquire a 139 km² copper-silver exploration portfolio in Morocco, including a 19 km² mining license, for C$4.0 million payable in Aya common shares. The portfolio is located ~35 km west of its Zgounder mine and includes high-grade surface samples. Closing is subject to customary conditions and TSX approval.

About: Aya Gold & Silver Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the exploration, evaluation, and development of precious metals projects in Morocco. The company primarily explores for gold and silver deposits. Its flagship project holds 100% interests in the Zgounder property located east of Agadir in the Proterozoic Siroua Massif of the Anti-Atlas Range, Morocco covering an area of approximately 378 square kilometers. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Mount Royal, Canada.

  • Deal value: C$4.0M
  • Consideration: stock
  • Announced: 2026-09-01
  • Next catalyst: TSX approval

item.scanner:headline: Acquired by FOX for $96 cash + 0.9693 FOXA/share; vote Oct 14
item.description:
Acquired by FOX for $96 cash + 0.9693 FOXA/share; vote Oct 14

Will be acquired by Fox Corporation in a two-step merger. Roku stockholders receive $96.00 cash plus 0.9693 FOX Class A shares per Roku share (implied value ~$161.16 as of Aug 27, 2026). Former Roku stockholders will own ~27% of the combined company. Special meetings for both companies' stockholders are scheduled for October 14, 2026.

About: Roku, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a TV streaming platform in the United States and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Platform and Devices. Its streaming platform allows users to find and access TV shows, movies, news, sports, and others, as well as offers digital advertising services. The company also sells streaming players, Roku-branded TVs, smart home products and services, audio products, and related accessories. Roku, Inc.

item.description:
Settles Cascia v. Farmer; amends voting pact with CK Amarillo

Entered into an amended and restated voting agreement with CK Amarillo LP in connection with settlement of the Cascia v. Farmer litigation. The agreement restricts CK Amarillo's voting on shares exceeding 45% of voting power to mirror other shareholders, and includes a sale-of-control provision requiring CK Amarillo to pay other shareholders the excess of any sale price above market if it sells 50% or more of outstanding shares.

About: Hertz Global Holdings, Inc. operates as a vehicle rental company. It operates through two segments: Americas RAC and International RAC. The company offers vehicle rental services under the Hertz, Dollar, and Thrifty brands from company-operated, licensee, and franchisee locations in the United States, Africa, Asia, Australia, Canada, the Caribbean, Europe, Latin America, the Middle East, and New Zealand. It also sells vehicles and value-added services.

item.scanner:headline: Spins off seed business into Vylor; exchange offers consents secured
item.description:
Spins off seed business into Vylor; exchange offers consents secured

Corteva's previously announced separation into two independent companies (crop protection and seed) is progressing. Vylor Inc., the seed subsidiary, received requisite consents for its exchange offers and consent solicitations on EIDP notes and entered a fourth supplemental indenture. The exchange offers are conditioned on consummation of the separation, expected to occur substantially simultaneously with the exchange settlement.

About: Corteva, Inc. operates in the agriculture business. The company operates through two segments, Seed and Crop Protection. The Seed segment develops and supplies advanced germplasm and traits that produce optimum yield for farms. It offers trait technologies that enhance resistance to weather, disease, insects, and herbicides used to control weeds, as well as food and nutritional characteristics.

  • Next catalyst: Separation consummation
